ASEAN Museum
Adventure

Unit 4 • Task 2 • True / False Game

How to play

  • Four teams take turns.
  • Choose one ASEAN Mystery Card.
  • It may be a statement or a Lucky Turn!
  • Statement: choose TRUE or FALSE.
  • Correct: +10 points. Show the evidence: +5 bonus.
  • Lucky Turn: get points or a special power.
